canonical_lines: THE JANUARY IDEA WAS NOT THE ANSWER; IT WAS THE SEARCH ARCHITECTURE.
WHAT SURVIVED WAS RECURSION, COLLABORATION, ALTERNATE REPRESENTATION AND VERIFICATION.
WHAT DID NOT SURVIVE WAS RANDOMNESS OR AI CONFIDENCE AS PROOF.
FUNDAMENTUM IS THE HARDENED DESCENDANT OF THE EARLY GAME-LAB IDEA.
P VS NP REMAINS OPEN; THE RECEIPT PROVES PROJECT LINEAGE, NOT THEOREM STATUS.
